messages:
Mike (sales): Hey team — MeridianHealth wants a SOC 2 report excerpt + NDA + an interim bridge letter so they can start the POC next week. Can we expedite?
Aisha (solutions): Good to know. Do they need Hosted or Dedicated/Private? That affects what we can commit for encryption / KMS.
Clare (legal): We can provide our standard NDA today via DocuSign. For a bridge letter we need confirmed scope (which systems, retention, and audience). Please share MeridianHealth's vendor risk checklist.
Jordan (security): Quick Qs — do they require us to use their KMS, or is our managed KMS fine? Also: will they request raw logs/evidence access or just redacted SOC2 extracts?
Ben (pricing): Pricing heads-up: if they want Dedicated capacity for the POC there may be a short-term reservation fee. Hosted trial is quicker but we need explicit DPA + data handling addendum.
Mike (sales): They said: POC will ingest PHI-adjacent metadata (no raw PHI), retention 90 days, prefer our managed KMS but want assurance we use customer-managed keys later. They asked for presigned S3 access for evidence exchange and a bridge letter confirming SOC2 controls in place during the POC window.
Aisha (solutions): For the POC we can stand up a dedicated pool in their VPC (Private) — turnaround ~3 business days. Host option can be ready same day but needs the DPA signed and a short data handling addendum for presigned S3.
Clare (legal): I have a bridge-letter template we use for interim requests. I'll need: (1) exact consumer of the letter (legal contact), (2) scope of systems, and (3) audience restrictions. Once I have that, I can prod Compliance for sign-off.
Jordan (security): @Mike please ask MeridianHealth to complete the SIG Lite subset (we can share a prefilled version). That speeds vendor review. We can also provide a redacted SOC2 excerpt showing control families and last test date.
Mike (sales): On the presigned S3 — they requested an example command to upload evidence. Sharing snippet now:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://meridian-evidence/poc.zip --expires-in 3600
```
Is that ok, or do we need to wrap in our transfer flow?
Aisha (solutions): The snippet is fine for their side. For us, we prefer they upload to a short-lived bucket we control, then we pull into their POC instance. That avoids accidental long-lived exposure. I'll add that to the runbook.
Clare (legal): I'll draft NDA + bridge letter + a redacted SOC2 excerpt. Also will add a short addendum for presigned S3 usage and retention 90 days. If Compliance flags anything I'll escalate.
deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope created: envelope_id=env_0a1b2c3; status=sent; reviewer=Clare (legal).
Ben (pricing): Mike — once they confirm Hosted vs Dedicated I'll post two line-item options (monthly POC fee + optional reserved pool). If they want KMS-integration later we can add that as a professional services item.
Mike (sales): I'll request MeridianHealth's vendor contact and SIG Lite answers this morning and push the DocuSign link. Aiming to get signed NDA + ack on bridge letter scope by EOD.
Aisha (solutions): I'll prep the POC runbook with both paths (hosted + private) and include estimated lead times and cost delta. Will drop the doc link here when done.
Clare (legal): Plan: NDA + bridge + redacted SOC2 excerpt out by 5pm PT today. If MeridianHealth needs a fully unredacted report we require an executed NDA + legal intake and Cust-Support workflow.
Mike (sales): Thanks team — looping in MeridianHealth now. Will update in this thread. :thumbsup:
